purpose: Test whether Stage5 failure is primarily cross-scale dictionary/centering mismatch by constructing a scale-matched 1.7B surrogate ancestry field for seed 23 only.
target: existing Stage5 seed-23 Qwen3-1.7B Mixture-KD student; no student retraining

surrogate_experts.data: exact frozen formal domain training JSONL used for the original controlled experts
surrogate_experts.recipe: same v0.11 QLoRA recipe: r16 alpha32 dropout0.05, all Q/K/V/O and MLP projections, 1 epoch, batch1 x grad_accum16, lr2e-4, cosine, prompt-masked response loss

measurement: existing deterministic Stage5 seed-23 Active-B32 and Random-B32 union, greedy max_new_tokens=96, all-mpnet-base-v2

pilot_gate.action_if_pass: expand only this diagnostic to seeds 47 and 71 before any L7 run
pilot_gate.action_if_fail: do not train the remaining surrogate experts; revise IFRF/cross-scale representation before L7

guardrails: The scale-matched 1.7B experts are diagnostic surrogates and are not the true genealogical 4B teachers.
No support threshold or conformal guarantee from Stage4 is claimed for this G1 diagnostic.
Do not tune on KD target responses beyond applying the frozen pilot branch rule.
Do not modify Stage1-5 original run roots or results.
